verdict.rationale: Postmark's first-party docs describe a dedicated inbound feature set: inbound processing, configuring an inbound server, inbound domain forwarding (the MX-pointing path), parsing an email, inbound blocking, a sample inbound workflow, and API endpoints to retry or bypass rules on failed or blocked inbound messages. The evidence is mostly section titles, so the specific parsed payload is not shown. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the parsed payload contents (headers, body, attachments) and of webhook delivery of inbound messages, and independent or hands-on corroboration of inbound parsing.
